en: Upon the dawn of a new decade something sinister brews within the heart of China, an ailment that threatens the existence of humanity. A highly infectious respiratory disease ravages Wuhan and is quickly making ground outside her borders. Can you brace your nation against the infection of a lifetime that will change everything we know?
